About the neighborhood — and why Strivers’ Row is special:

Strivers’ Row (officially the St. Nicholas Historic District) is a landmarked block of late 19th-century rowhouses protected by the New York City Landmarks Preservation Commission and listed on the National Register of Historic Places. The brownstones here have been owned by the same families for generations — this is not a transient block. It’s a genuine community with deep roots and real neighbors who look out for each other. West Harlem has transformed significantly and continues to thrive, but Strivers’ Row in particular has always been a safe, quiet, residential enclave — tree-lined, grounded, and proud.

About me (your roommate)

I work in finance, love a calm home, and treat my apartment like a sanctuary. I love interior design and have loved making this space into a fun home for me and my dog. I have a miniature schnauzer who is hypoallergenic, elderly, quiet, and honestly just sleeps. She’s sweet and unobtrusive — you’ll barely know she’s there. I’m looking for someone clean, respectful, and who keeps the party elsewhere. Chill, professional energy preferred.

Five month Sublease w/ extension
Room for rent in 4 bedroom townhouse. The space is the bottom two stories of a duplex in Jersey City, NJ. 

The room is $1100/month and shares a bathroom with one other person.

The house has 4 roommates, all of whom are working and have varied schedules. It is three males and one female, two of whom are in the separate basement unit that is only accessible through the garage. 

The other two second floor roommates work in office, one who works until 10pm and the other who gets home around 7pm. 

The lightrail is a 9 minute walk from the house, and you can get to the city in about 30 minutes via light rail —> PATH or via bus. 

Groceries and local restaurants are only one block away on either side of the house, and it’s good for anyone looking for an affordable and clean place to live!

Lease ends in September with possible extension!
